subject.title: feat(android): add Wear real-time Talk controls

question: Should OpenClaw permanently bundle this Wear real-time Talk surface and accept its new Wear protocol and Gateway/provider language contracts?
rationale: The implementation is proven and structurally coherent, but it expands bundled app behavior and compatibility-sensitive protocol/API surfaces that require owner intent.

options.title: Accept bundled Wear Talk
options.body: Approve the Wear RPC/audio and Talk language contracts, then require an exact-head rebase and completed validation before merge.

options.title: Narrow the contracts
options.body: Keep the Wear experience but revise or internalize protocol and language additions that should not become permanent APIs.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer or close the PR if real-time Talk is not currently an accepted bundled Wear OS direction.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled Wear Talk
recommendation.body: Approve the Wear RPC/audio and Talk language contracts, then require an exact-head rebase and completed validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged Wear proxy foundation and its credential boundary originate from this owner’s work.
